la: Tell students which file format to use

sections.title: A file D2L can't open
sections.text: Tell the student which format to use. They convert it themselves.

cells: Export as PDF from the app
Set the iPhone Camera to Most Compatible, or export the photo as JPG

sections.title: Hands off student files
list: Don't take a student's file, convert it, edit it or upload it for them, and don't send it to a converter website.
Lab videos are the student's job too: the Bongo recording, or the backup MP4 in the Troubleshooting tab of Content > LAB.
Still stuck? The student emails {email} with a screenshot.
